title: Jamanra, the Risen King Guide: Flame Circle, Lightning Orbs and the Halani Gates Fight
summary: A partial Act 2 main encounter at the Halani Gates. Learn the flame safe circle, slow Lightning Orbs, Volatile Beetles and why the fight retracts at ~30% HP — distinct from the Abomination.
description: How to beat Jamanra, the Risen King in Path of Exile 2 Act 2: flame circle, lightning orbs, identity difference vs the Abomination and the retreat ending.
author: Exile2 Guides
imageAlt: Jamanra the Risen King stabbing his sword to form a flame safe circle

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: When he stabs his sword into the ground, stand INSIDE the flame circle — the area outside it becomes dangerous.
calloutDetail: This is a partial encounter: the fight ends when he retreats at low health, it is not a full kill.
It is a different boss from Jamanra, the Abomination at the Dreadnought.

answers.label: Is this the Act 2 final boss?
answers.text: No. The Risen King is a mid-Act 2 gate fight; the Abomination is the Act 2 finale.

answers.label: Why does it end at 30%?
answers.text: He retreats by design once his health drops — push him there, then the story continues.

answers.label: Safe circle?
answers.text: Stay inside the flame ring he creates with the sword stab; outside is the danger zone.

facts.label: Fight type
facts.note: Ends at retreat, not at 0% HP.

facts.label: After retreat
facts.note: The path stays sandstorm-blocked until later; this is expected.

steps.label: Reach the Halani Gates
body: Follow the main path past Mawdun Mine.
The gate arena opens as the objective triggers.

items.label: Fire resistance
checks: Flame Burst and the safe-circle edge deal Fire.
items.why: Standing outside the circle exposes you to fire.
items.fix: Raise Fire res; respect the circle.

items.label: Lightning coverage
checks: Lightning Orbs and Beam are lightning.
items.why: Orbs track slowly; the Beam has a clear tell.
items.fix: Keep moving; dodge the Beam laterally.

items.label: Add clear
checks: Volatile Beetles spawn during the fight.
items.fix: Clear beetles that block your circle entry.

items.label: Movement speed
checks: You must reach the circle in time.

sections.title: Arena Reading
paragraphs: The Halani Gates is an open courtyard. The signature moment is the sword stab: a flame ring appears, and the ground outside it turns hazardous.
This is a partial encounter — once Jamanra's health drops far enough he retreats. The forward path remains sandstorm-blocked afterwards; that is intended, not a bug.
bullets: Blue = approach lane. Orange = Lightning Orb path. Green = flame safe circle. Red = outside-circle danger.

phases.label: Phase 1: Halani Gates Encounter
phases.trigger: Fight starts at full health; retracts at low health.
objectives: Trigger the flame circle and enter it
notes: Partial encounter — ends at retreat, not a kill.
The sword stab creates the safe circle; outside is dangerous.

attacks.name: Flame Burst / Safe Circle
telegraph: Stabs sword into ground; a flame ring forms.
responses: Step inside the ring; outside becomes dangerous.
commonMistakes: Standing just outside the ring edge.
notes: The ring is the safe zone, not the sword.

attacks.name: Lightning Orbs
responses: Lead them away from the circle; keep moving.
commonMistakes: Letting orbs pin you outside the ring.
notes: Slow but tracking; do not stand still.

attacks.name: Summon Scarab / Volatile Beetles
responses: Clear beetles blocking your circle entry.
commonMistakes: Ignoring beetles then missing the circle.
notes: Beetles clutter timing, not huge damage.

attacks.name: Lightning Beam
responses: Dodge laterally out of the line.

attacks.name: Sandstorm & Volatile Beetles
responses: Keep to the circle; ignore the flavour storm.
notes: The blocking storm after the fight is separate from combat.

types.label: Fire
mitigation: Fire res and the safe circle.
notes: Flame Burst and circle edge are Fire.

types.label: Physical
notes: Beetles and storm are physical pressure.

sections.title: Strategy and Key Mechanics
paragraphs: Identity Difference — Risen King vs Abomination:
Location: Halani Gates vs the Dreadnought. Role: mid-Act 2 gate vs Act 2 finale. Ending: retreats at low health vs full finale fight. Slug: jamanra-the-risen-king vs jamanra-the-abomination.

Do not reuse the Abomination's sandstorm/Asala finale mechanics here. Do not call this the Act 2 final boss. Do not rely on dying to let Asala auto-finish — that is the Abomination fight, not this one.
bullets: When the sword stabs, the circle is safe; outside is the kill zone.
Lead Lightning Orbs away from the circle before they pin you.
After retreat, the path stays sandstorm-blocked — that is intended.

rewards.label: Halani Gates Progress
notes: The encounter completes when he retreats at low health.
Story continues; the forward sandstorm lifts later in the campaign.

entries.question: Is the Risen King the Act 2 final boss?
summary: Players expect a full kill and are confused when he leaves.
editorialAnalysis: He is a partial gate encounter, not the finale.
officialAnswer: No — the Abomination at the Dreadnought is the Act 2 finale. Push the Risen King to retreat.

entries.question: Where do I stand during the sword stab?
summary: Players stand outside the ring and die.
editorialAnalysis: The ring is the safe zone; outside is dangerous.
officialAnswer: Step inside the flame circle when he stabs the sword.

entries.question: Why is the path still blocked by sandstorm?
editorialAnalysis: The post-fight blocking storm is intended story gating.
officialAnswer: Continue the campaign; the storm lifts later. This is not a bug.

problems.symptom: He ran away and I did not get the kill.
directAnswer: That is correct — he retreats by design at low health. Push him there to complete the encounter.
checks: Do not wait for a 0% kill.

problems.symptom: I die right after the sword stab.
directAnswer: You are outside the flame circle. Step inside it when he stabs the sword.
checks: Move into the ring, not beside it.

directAnswer: They track slowly — keep moving and lead them away from the circle before they trap you outside.
checks: Clear beetles that block your path.
